list.name: Shared Runtime Layer
list.description: Shared Python runtime services, LLM integrations, security helpers, observability, and reusable UI support used across the AI systems.

list.name: Portfolio UI Layer
list.description: Next.js portfolio pages, client components, and presentation assets for exploring the shared AI systems.

list.name: Generative AI Systems Layer
list.description: Standalone generative-AI application modules covering research, knowledge, document intelligence, clinical, financial, browser, code, interview, UI, and NL2SQL workflows.

list.name: LangGraph Systems Layer
list.description: LangGraph-based agent workflows, graph nodes, planners, executors, and supporting application code.

list.name: CrewAI Systems Layer
list.description: CrewAI multi-agent applications defining agents, tasks, crews, and runnable collaborative workflows.

list.name: Quality and Evaluation Layer
list.description: Pytest coverage and executable benchmark providers used to verify runtime behavior and compare system quality.

list.name: Data Layer
list.description: Database migration assets and extracted tabular data definitions that support persistent system state.

list.name: Documentation Layer
list.description: Project guides, module READMEs, architecture references, and generated reports for users and maintainers.

list.name: Infrastructure and CI Layer
list.description: Container build definitions, Docker support files, repository automation, and continuous-integration workflows.

list.name: Project Support and Generated Artifacts Layer
list.description: Project configuration, tooling metadata, generated graph artifacts, and analysis support files that enable development and repository maintenance.
